overview_description.description: Tripwire is a leading provider of advanced threat, security and compliance solutions that enable enterprises, service providers and government agencies to confidently detect, prevent and respond to cybersecurity threats. Tripwire solutions are based on high-fidelity asset visibility and deep endpoint intelligence combined with business-context and enable security automation through enterprise integration. Tripwire’s portfolio of enterprise-class security solutions includes configuration and policy management, file integrity monitoring, vulnerability management and log intelligence. Learn more at www.tripwire.com, get security news, trends and insights at http://www.tripwire.com/state-of-security/ or follow us on Twitter @TripwireInc.

product.name: Tripwire Enterprise
product.description: A security solution combining file integrity monitoring and security configuration management to detect unauthorized changes and enforce compliance in real time.

product.name: File Integrity and Change Monitoring
product.description: A solution that automatically detects unauthorized and suspicious changes using real-time data and security automation.

product.name: Security Configuration Management (SCM)
product.description: A service that continuously hardens systems by managing and enforcing security configurations to reduce attack surfaces.

product.name: Vulnerability and Risk Management
product.description: A solution that identifies and prioritizes security risks by combining vulnerability data with business context.

product.name: Managed Cybersecurity Services
product.description: A service that outsources operational cybersecurity tasks to Tripwire experts to support and extend existing security staff.
